target.title: fix(openai): bound embedding batch file downloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenAI-compatible embedding batch runs could buffer an unbounded batch output or error file response when downloading `/files/{id}/content`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OpenAI embedding batch file-content path now uses the shared provider text response reader, matching the bounded JSON/status paths and rejecting oversized streamed output before parsing it. Normal under-limit JSONL output behavior is unchanged.

## User Impact

Users running OpenAI-compatible embedding batches are protected from a faulty or hostile provider endpoint streaming an oversized file-content response into gateway memory.

## Evidence

Real loopback HTTP proof: the regression test drives `runOpenAiEmbeddingBatches` through a real local `node:http` server whose `/files/output-0/content` endpoint streams an oversized batch output file. The bounded reader rejects before parsing the file content.
